name: Sequisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
When all that is false and misleading crumbles, the truth will remain standing strong. Sequisitors ask theological questions with the rhetorical intention to destroy opposing faiths. Masters of religious debate, sequisitors probe the philosophies of enemy religions for weaknesses in order to destroy them.

Domain

A sequisitor must select Destruction as her domain, even if her deity does not grant it.

This alters domain.

Deconstructive Inquiries (Sp)

Starting at 4th level, a sequisitor adds the 1st-6th level domain spells from the Destruction domain to her list of spells known.

This replaces bane, greater bane, and third judgment.

Question Integrity (Sp)

At 14th level, a sequisitor can use disintegrate as a spell-like ability once per day, using her Wisdom to determine her concentration checks and the save DC.

This replaces exploit weakness.

Rock the Foundations (Sp)

At 16th level, a sequisitor can use earthquake as a spell-like ability once per day, using her Wisdom to determine her concentration checks.

This replaces the additional use per day of judgment gained at 16th level.

Look Inward (Sp)

At 17th level, a sequisitor can use implosion once per day as a spell-like ability, using her Wisdom to determine her concentration checks and the save DC.

This replaces slayer.
